title: Determining the Particle Size Distribution of an LiFePO4 Electrode for Full-Cell Many-Particle Modeling
authors: Josef Eizenhammer, Michael Schrattenberger, Marcel Rogge, Yannis Riedel, Christoph Macho, Veronika Vachenauer and Andreas Jossen
abstract: <mark>Lithium</mark> iron phosphate (LFP) electrodes exhibit history-dependent electrode behavior. It originates from particle-level phase-change behavior, which strongly depends on the particle size distribution (PSD). Current modeling approaches for LFP either assume a uniform particle size, a predefined PSD, or determine the PSD through resource-intensive imaging techniques. Extending these approaches, this work introduces a thermodynamically grounded methodology for determining the PSD from low-current half-cell experiments.
